name: UlforceVeedramon (X Antibody)
main_effect:
[When Digivolving] Unsuspend this Digimon or 1 of your blue Tamers.
[All Turns] [Once Per Turn] When this Digimon becomes unsuspended, if you have a blue Tamer in play or this Digimon has [UlforceVeedramon] in its digivolution cards, return 1 of your opponent's Digimon with the lowest level to its owner's hand.
tcgplayer_name: UlforceVeedramon (X Antibody) (24-25 World Championship Finals Champion)
